banner.title: sonarr
banner.tagline: Tracks wanted TV series, grabs Usenet releases through Prowlarr and SABnzbd, and imports the episodes into the NAS library.

explainer.title: From a wanted episode to a file in the library

steps.title: State
steps.text: The init-db container makes sure the sonarr database and role exist on shared postgres-18-rw. Settings live in the sonarr-config claim.
steps.scene: a stack of database cylinders with a small key

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Sonarr asks the indexers that Prowlarr provides for each wanted episode, then ranks the releases by the Recyclarr scores.
steps.scene: a magnifying glass over a row of episode cards

steps.title: Grab
steps.text: The chosen NZB goes to SABnzbd, which downloads and repairs it on shared-downloads.
steps.scene: a download arrow dropping a folder into a tray

steps.title: Import
steps.text: Sonarr copies the finished episode from /data/downloads into /data/nas-media. Every import is a copy, because CephFS and NFS cannot hardlink.
steps.scene: an episode file being copied onto a library shelf

steps.title: Back up
steps.text: kopiur snapshots sonarr-config to Ceph every four hours and to R2 at 11:00 New York time, daily.
steps.scene: a shield over a cube and a cloud
